items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was one with James Hamilton, the Duke Ellington...

ctx.x: Not necessarily. I don’t remember, quite honestly. No. Wait a minute. There was one
with James Hamilton, the Duke Ellington... No-no-no, it’s not the first one... Maybe it was! First of all, I adored James P. Johnson...
